description: This Java class 'RemoveUnneededTraces' is designed for processing and optimizing PCB layout files by removing unneeded segments and vias from the PCB node structure. It factors in connectivity to identify and delete unused traces to streamline the design.

classes.name: RemoveUnneededTraces
classes.description: A utility class that encapsulates static methods for analyzing and removing unused segments and vias from a PCB layout represented by PcbNode objects.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for executing PCB optimization; takes input and output file paths as arguments and performs the removal process.

methods.name: optimize
methods.description: Loads a PCB node structure from a file, iteratively removes unused segments and vias until no more can be removed, and writes the optimized structure to an output file.

methods.name: removeUnusedVias
methods.description: Finds and removes vias that are not connected to any segments, based on net ID and connection counts.

methods.name: findUnusedVias
methods.description: Identifies vias in the PCB node structure that are unused or disconnected, suitable for removal.

methods.name: removeUnusedSegments
methods.description: Removes segments from the PCB that are not connected to any modules or other segments.

methods.name: findUnusedSegments
methods.description: Helper method to find segments that are unused based on connectivity criteria.

methods.name: isUnused
methods.description: Determines if a given segment node can be considered unused by checking connectivity at its start and end points.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks whether a point is connected to other segments or modules within a list of PCB nodes, returning a connecting node if found.
